data.name: Suny
data.gender_notes: Suny is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word ‘Surya’ meaning sun, Suny is a name that evokes the bright and radiant energies of the sun. It is a name that represents warmth, vitality, and illumination. The name Suny carries the meaning “Bright, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Suny usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Suny is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the sun is a symbol of the divine, and that it represents the source of all life and energy. Suny is a name that can inspire a deep connection to the spiritual world, and can help to bring light and warmth into one's life.
data.etymology: Suny belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suny total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
